key_insight: S$^3$R speeds up long-context RL rollouts by using sparse attention only for drafting, then full-attention speculative verification to preserve the exact dense-policy response groups needed for stable group-relative learning.
engineering_relevance: The method targets the main RLVR bottleneck—KV-cache traffic during autoregressive decoding—while keeping training behavior faithful to dense-policy rollouts.
method: Use self-sparse speculative decoding to propose tokens with sparse attention.
Verify drafted responses with full attention and exact speculative sampling so the final group distribution matches dense policy.
Add a KV-aware scheduler to reduce repeated KV-cache offloading/restoration during verification.
evidence_signal: In long-context mathematical reasoning on Qwen3, S$^3$R reached about 1.39× to 1.35× end-to-end training throughput versus autoregressive rollouts with comparable task performance.
watch_item: Dense verification still needs the full historical KV cache, so memory movement and cache management remain a practical bottleneck.
paper_title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
